meta.inspection: All 45 PNGs individually opened using view_image. Prior exact identical-image anchors preserved from own review/image hashes. No source, key or other judges inspected.
meta.blinding_limitations: Repeated controls and visual families recognizable. Sci-fi resembles StarCraft and battlefield references Company of Heroes; tactical title uncertain. No presumed iteration advantage.

general_next_priorities: Keep dark hull rim and establish consistent directional top/side lighting rather than a uniformly pale perimeter.
Make foam irregular connected bodies tied to beach edge, not detached offshore strokes.
Resolve pale plane/deck and blue plane/roof overlaps within the useful player ring.
Dense battle needs major/minor effect hierarchy and less repeated rosette smoke; more detail alone does not improve readability.
Ground terrain with meaningful relief and softer varied contacts instead of uniform grass noise and repeated dark tree disks.
